System name ('Content Management System'); central to this ticket — the preview feature lives inside the CMS, and cx-shared references Contentstack, a CMS product.

Part of the feature name 'Live Preview'; distinguishes this real-time preview capability from static build previews.
CMS content concept; also appears in the Contentstack Migration Tool in cx-shared. Names a data domain in the software, not just the persona 'Content Author'.

Page/section name ('Discover Article pages'); a named page in the front-end candidates — a route or component identifier, not generic vocabulary.
